name: T. J. Sharkey
bio: T. J. Sharkey was the Northern Pacific's traveling auditor, who came through Belfield and Medora in 1884 and 1885 to inspect station and express accounts. In December 1885 he protested, with citizens, a proposed change in Maxwell's position.
